Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. ## Summary

This is the **usememos/memos** repo (Go backend + React frontend). Memo derived metadata is computed in two places with two different lifecycles: **persisted properties** (computed on write, stored in DB) and **ephemeral snippet** (computed on every read/API response, not stored).

### 1. Where the derived metadata is computed

**A. Persisted properties — `internal/markdown/markdown.go`**

- `ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)` — lines 356-421 (main single-pass extractor, used in production)
- `ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)` — lines 192-241 (equivalent standalone version)
- `ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)` — lines 142-170
- Helper `extractHeadingText` / `extractTextFromNode` — lines 172-190 (used to pull the H1 title text)

Both walk the goldmark AST once and extract:
```go
// lines 383-408 (inside ExtractAll)
if !firstBlockChecked && n.Parent() != nil && n.Parent().Kind() == gast.KindDocument {
    firstBlockChecked = true
    if heading, ok := n.(*gast.Heading); ok && heading.Level == 1 {
        data.Property.Title = extractHeadingText(n, content)
    }
}
switch n.Kind() {
case gast.KindLink:
    data.Property.HasLink = true
case gast.KindCodeBlock, gast.KindFencedCodeBlock, gast.KindCodeSpan:
    data.Property.HasCode = true
case east.KindTaskCheckBox:
    data.Property.HasTaskList = true
    if checkBox, ok := n.(*east.TaskCheckBox); ok {
        if !checkBox.IsChecked {
            data.Property.HasIncompleteTasks = true
        }
    }
}
```
Tags/mentions are also collected during the same walk (lines 376-381) and deduped case-preserving (`uniquePreserveCase`, line ~456).

**Orchestration wrapper — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`**
```go
// line 74
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
    if memo.Payload == nil {
        memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
    }
    data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
    ...
    memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
    memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
    return nil
}
```

**B. Ephemeral snippet/preview — `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, `GenerateSnippet`**
- lines 263-346, `GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)` — walks the AST building plain text (skipping code blocks, keeping tags/links as text), truncates at word boundary via `truncateAtWord`, returns a trimmed plain-text preview.
- Called through the thin wrapper `getMemoContentSnippet` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89`:
```go
func (s *APIV1Service) getMemoContentSnippet(content string) (string, error) {
    snippet, err := s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)
    ...
    return snippet, nil
}
```

### 2. What triggers recomputation

**Persisted `Property`/`Tags` (title, hasLink, hasCode, hasTaskList, hasIncompleteTasks, tags):**
- **On memo create**: `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` inside `CreateMemo` — `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` before `s.Store.CreateMemo`.
- **On memo content update**: `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` inside `UpdateMemo`, only when the update mask includes the `content` path (line 436 `if path == "content"`) — `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService)`, then persisted via `update.Payload = memo.Payload`.
- **Batch backfill / migration tool**: `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, `Runner.RunOnce(ctx)` (lines 27-72) — paginates through all memos in batches of 100 via `Store.ListMemos` and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each. Note: this runner is **not currently wired into `server/server.go`'s scheduled/startup runners** (only `s3presign.NewRunner` is invoked there at `server.go:162-163`); it exists as a standalone reusable batch job (e.g., for future migrations/backfills) but isn't on an active cron path in this codebase snapshot.
- These are NOT recomputed on plain reads — they are stored in `MemoPayload.Property`/`.Tags` (proto: `proto/store/memo.proto`) and just passed through on read via `convertMemoPropertyFromStore` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:319-324`.

**Ephemeral `Snippet` (preview text):**
- Recomputed on **every read/API conversion**, not stored — `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80` calls `s.getMemoContentSnippet(memo.Content)` each time a memo is converted from store to API response (covers `GetMemo`, `ListMemos`, etc.).
- Also recomputed for related-memo previews: `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:154,162` (`getMemoContentSnippet` for both a memo and its related memo).
- Also recomputed for batch relation conversion: `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:173-273` (`batchConvertMemoRelations`, populates `memoIDToSnippet` map, conditioned on `includeSnippets`).
- Also recomputed for notification payloads: `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:318-391` (`memoNotificationSnippet`), used when building comment/mention notification payloads (`MemoSnippet`, `RelatedMemoSnippet`).

### 3. Specific properties derived

From `proto/store/memo.proto` (`MemoPayload.Property` message):
```proto
message Property {
  bool has_link = 1;
  bool has_task_list = 2;
  bool has_code = 3;
  bool has_incomplete_tasks = 4;
  // The title extracted from the first H1 heading, if present.
  string title = 5;
}
```
Plus `MemoPayload.tags` (repeated string), computed in the same pass.

- **title** — extracted only if the *first block-level node* of the document is an H1 heading (`ExtractAll`/`ExtractProperties`, lines 384-389 / 208-213).
- **has_link** — true if any `gast.KindLink` node exists.
- **has_code** — true if any code block, fenced code block, or code span exists.
- **has_task_list** — true if any GFM task checkbox exists.
- **has_incomplete_tasks** — true if any unchecked task checkbox exists.
- **tags** — all `#tag` nodes (deduped, case preserved, excluding tags inside links/images — `isTagNodeInLinkOrImage`, line 122).
- **mentions** — also extracted in `ExtractedData.Mentions` (lowercased `@username`s) but this is used transiently for mention-notification dispatch, not stored on the memo payload.
- **snippet** — a ~64-character (`maxLength=64` in `getMemoContentSnippet`) plain-text preview/excerpt built by walking the AST, skipping code blocks, joining block-level text with spaces, truncated to the nearest word boundary. This is computed fresh on every API response and is not persisted to the database (no "word count"/"reading time" fields exist in this codebase).

**Store struct**: `store/memo.go:35` defines `type Memo struct { ... Payload *storepb.MemoPayload ... }`, and the `Property` sub-struct fields (`HasLink`, `HasTaskList`, `HasCode`, `HasIncompleteTasks`) are referenced for filtering/stats in `internal/filter/schema.go:186-244` and `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:142-151,258-267`.</result>

**Computation site:**
- `internal/markdown/markdown.go` — `ExtractAll` (lines 356-421, also `ExtractProperties` lines 192-241 and `ExtractTags` lines 142-170) walks the goldmark AST once to derive persisted properties; `GenerateSnippet` (lines 263-346) walks the AST to build an ephemeral preview.
- Persisted extraction is orchestrated by `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which calls `ExtractAll` and assigns the results to `memo.Payload.Tags` / `memo.Payload.Property`.
- Snippet extraction is invoked per-request via `getMemoContentSnippet` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89`, which calls `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)`.

**Triggers:**
- Persisted `Property`/`Tags`: recomputed via `RebuildMemoPayload` on `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`) and on `UpdateMemo` only when the update mask includes the `content` field path (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:436-447`). A standalone batch runner (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, `RunOnce`) can also rebuild it for all memos in pages of 100, though it isn't currently wired into a scheduled/startup job in `server/server.go`. These fields are stored in the DB and are *not* recomputed on plain reads.
- Ephemeral `Snippet`: recomputed on every read/API conversion — in `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80`) for `GetMemo`/`ListMemos`, in `memo_relation_service.go:154,162` for related-memo previews, in batch relation conversion (`memo_service_converter.go:173-273`), and in notification payload building (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:318-391`). It is never persisted.

**Extracted properties:**
- `title` — text of the first block-level node if it's an H1 heading.
- `has_link` — presence of any link node.
- `has_code` — presence of code block/fenced code block/code span.
- `has_task_list` / `has_incomplete_tasks` — presence of GFM task checkboxes / unchecked ones.
- `tags` — all `#tag` occurrences (deduped, case-preserved, excluding tags inside links/images).
- (transient only, not persisted) `mentions` — `@username`s used for notification dispatch.
- `snippet` — ~64-char plain-text preview built by walking the AST (skipping code blocks), truncated at a word boundary; computed fresh per response, not stored.

Proto definition of the persisted fields: `proto/store/memo.proto`, `MemoPayload.Property` (`has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `title`) plus `MemoPayload.tags`.
